question: A conical party hat has a slant height of 10 cm and a radius of 7 cm. What is its curved surface area? (Use π=3.14)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a cone = π × radius (r) × slant height (l)

Given: r = 7 cm, l = 10 cm, π = 3.14

CSA = 3.14 × 7 × 10

CSA = 3.14 × 70 = 219.8 cm²

**∴ The correct option is (2).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of the cone (r) = 7 cm

Slant height of the cone (l) = 10 cm

Value of π = 3.14

**Formula used:**

Curved Surface Area of a Cone = πrl

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a Cone

It is the sum of the curved surface area and the area of the circular base: TSA = πr(l + r).

Volume of a Cone

The volume represents the space occupied by the cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, where h is the vertical height.

Relation between l, r, and h

The slant height (l), vertical height (h), and radius (r) follow Pythagoras theorem: l² = r² + h² or l = √(r² + h²).</p
